The task: analyze which models/configurations have higher buyback value (保值率/retained value), and give specific vehicle buyback recommendations.

The buyback value can be approximated by the ratio of current used-car price to original new car price. So I need to compute a "retention ratio" = Price / New Car Price.

The Price is in some unit (probably 万元 = 10k yuan, since 34.98 for an Audi A6L new energy would be 349,800 yuan). New Car Price is text "551,400 yuan". So I need to parse Price (multiply by 10,000 if it's in 万元) and parse New Car Price from text.

Let me understand the data better. First check data types and units. Price values like 34.98, 31.8, 37.4, 8.58, 10.68, 21.99, 22.2, 28.6, 5.56, 25.9 - these look like 万元. New car price "551,400 yuan" = 551,400. So ratio = 34.98*10000 / 551400 = 0.634. Reasonable for a 1-year-old car.

Let me explore the data: total rows, price range, etc. Then compute retention ratio.

Also need to account for vehicle age (years since registration). A proper buyback value analysis should control for age. So compute annualized retention or group by age buckets.
